sequenceDiagram(name  =  "Password Reset")  {
    val user  = lifeline(name  =  "User")  { isActor  = true  }
    val webPortal  = lifeline(name  =  "Web Portal")
    val authService  = lifeline(name  =  "Authentication Service")
    val userDatabase  = lifeline(name  =  "User Database")
    val emailService  = lifeline(name  =  "Email Service")
    
    message(from  = user, to  = webPortal, label  =  "requests password reset")
    message(from  = webPortal, to  = authService, label  =  "resetPassword(email)")
    message(from  = authService, to  = userDatabase, label  =  "lookupEmail(email)")
    
    alt (exists)
        message(from  = userDatabase, to  = authService, label  =  "exists: true")
        message(from  = authService, to  = userDatabase, label  =  "generateResetToken()")
        message(from  = authService, to  = emailService, label  =  "sendResetEmail(email, token)")
        reply(from  = authService, to  = webPortal, label  =  "success")
    else (not exists)
        message(from  = userDatabase, to  = authService, label  =  "exists: false")
        reply(from  = authService, to  = webPortal, label  =  "success")
    end
    
    reply(from  = webPortal, to  = user, label  =  "password reset initiated")
}

    val apiGateway = lifeline(name = "API Gateway")
    val authService = lifeline(name = "Authentication Service")
    val orderService = lifeline(name = "Order Service")

    message(from = client, to = apiGateway, label = "Order Request with JWT")

    reply(from = cache, to = apiGateway, label = "No Cache Entry")

    message(from = apiGateway, to = orderService, label = "Forward Request")
    reply(from = orderService, to = apiGateway, label = "Order List")
    message(from = apiGateway, to = client, label = "Return Order List")
}

import dev.kuml.sysml2.dsl.sysml2Model

sysml2Model(name  =  "RobotArmModel")  {
    val base  = partDef(name  =  "Base")
    val endEffector  = partDef(name  =  "EndEffector")
    val revoluteJoint  = partDef(name  =  "RevoluteJoint") 
    val prismaticJoint  = partDef(name  =  "PrismaticJoint")
    val joint  = partDef(name  =  "Joint", isAbstract  =  true)  {
        part( name  =  "specializations", 
              typeId  =  revoluteJoint.id, 
              cardinality  =  "*") 
        part( name  =  "specializations", 
              typeId  =  prismaticJoint.id, 
              cardinality  =  "*") 
     }
    val arm  = partDef(name  =  "Arm")  {
        part( name  =  "base", 
              typeId  =  base.id) 
        part( name  =  "endEffector", 
              typeId  =  endEffector.id) 
        part( name  =  "joints", 
              typeId  =  joint.id, 
              cardinality  =  "1..6") 
     }
    bdd( name  =  "RobotArmModel BDD")  {
        include( arm) 
        include( base) 
        include( endEffector) 
        include( revoluteJoint) 
        include( prismaticJoint) 
        include( joint) 
     }
}

import dev.kuml.sysml2.dsl.sysml2Model

sysml2Model(name  =  "Electric Vehicle Drivetrain")  {
    val batteryCell  = partDef(name  =  "Battery Cell")
    val batteryModule  = partDef(name  =  "Battery Module")  {
        part(name  =  "cell", typeId  = batteryCell.id, cardinality  =  "*")
     }
    val batteryPack  = partDef(name  =  "Battery Pack")  {
        part(name  =  "module", typeId  = batteryModule.id, cardinality  =  "*")
     }
    val inverter  = partDef(name  =  "Inverter")
    val electricMotor  = partDef(name  =  "Electric Motor")
    val gearbox  = partDef(name  =  "Gearbox")
    val bms  = partDef(name  =  "Battery Management System")
    val thermalManagementSystem  = partDef(name  =  "Thermal Management System")
    val drivetrain  = partDef(name  =  "Drivetrain")  {
        part(name  =  "batteryPack", typeId  = batteryPack.id)
        part(name  =  "inverter", typeId  = inverter.id)
        part(name  =  "electricMotor", typeId  = electricMotor.id, cardinality  =  "*")
        part(name  =  "gearbox", typeId  = gearbox.id)
        part(name  =  "bms", typeId  = bms.id)
        part(name  =  "thermalManagementSystem", typeId  = thermalManagementSystem.id)
     }
    bdd(name  =  "Electric Vehicle Drivetrain BDD")  {
        include(batteryCell)
        include(batteryModule)
        include(batteryPack)
        include(inverter)
        include(electricMotor)
        include(gearbox)
        include(bms)
        include(thermalManagementSystem)
        include(drivetrain)
     }
}
